theorems.name: Submission.cbrz_finset_integral_hausdorff_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), (∫ x in (F : Set (Euclid P)), f x ∂μHE[0]) = ∑ x ∈ F, f x ∧ (∫⁻ x in (F : Set (Euclid P)), g x ∂μHE[0]) = ∑ x ∈ F, g x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
